## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 1 июн. 2026 г. - 22 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Aneya Saxena_, 1 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "Why is it so expensive. And why are only 3 habits free?? Thats too less."
            2. _suhas pednekar_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 5/5: "app is really good 😊 but price is too High please if you are reading this a genuine request please reduced the price make it cheaper.."
            3. _Rohan Shah_, 17 июл. 2026 г., 5/5: "With everyone on the planet having built a habit tracker and me having tried half of them, this is the one that finally clicked. It's simple, straightforward and understands it's users well. Got the lifetime subscription immediately and don't regret it! Try it out - high chance you won't need to switch"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 24 июл. 2026 г. - 12 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Jaroslav Holaň_, 24 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Unfortunately, the app only offers several dark themes. This makes it practically unusable for me because I need a light theme. A light interface is easier for me to read during the day, especially outdoors or in a well-lit room. Dark themes are less comfortable for my eyes, make navigation more difficult, and cause fatigue during longer use. I would therefore appreciate a proper light theme, ideally with the option to follow the phone’s system settings automatically."
            2. _Parth Magar_, 12 авг. 2026 г., 4/5: "hey app is just awesome but there is bug i am using widgets of habit the streak shown in app is different from the widgets streak keep both same..."
<!--/ir-theme-->
